title: Products with category names
prompt: Return each product's name along with its category name (as column category_name).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE categories (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO categories VALUES (1,'Hardware'),(2,'Toys'); CREATE TABLE products2 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, category_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO products2 VALUES (1,'Widget',1),(2,'Doll',2),(3,'Hammer',1);
reference_sql: SELECT products2.name, categories.name AS category_name FROM products2 JOIN categories ON products2.category_id = categories.id;
